messages:
maria (People Ops): Quick heads up — sophia submitted resignation this morning. Last day is 2026-04-10. Need to coordinate final paycheck, prorated bonus calc, COBRA timing, device return pickup, and access cutover. Assigning tasks below.

ken (IT): Got it. I can schedule device pickup for 2026-04-11 and plan SSO deprovision on 2026-04-10 18:00 PT. Please post asset serials so I can tag them for pickup.

sophia (Product): Confirming last day 4/10. I can drop devices at the SF office or request pickup. Prefer pickup to avoid travel.

maria (People Ops): Pickup preferred — ken, please use onsite courier. Also note COBRA timeline: coverage will remain through 04/30 per our plan year; COBRA election packet will be sent the business day after termination (target 2026-04-11).

alex (Finance): I will calculate final paycheck and prorated bonus. Need confirmation of termination date (4/10 ok) and whether manager is approving pro-rated bonus. Also need PTO balance — @maria can you confirm final PTO payout policy?

maria (People Ops): PTO payout is according to handbook (unused PTO paid out on final comp run). I'll run PTO balance and post numbers to #payroll-channel by 2026-04-07.

ken (IT): Please paste serials/asset tags here. Also flag any shared service accounts that need ownership transfer. I will create deprovision tickets for Slack/Google/AWS and mark them to run EOD 4/10 after archival.

sophia (Product): Asset info — Laptop and phone:
```
MacBook Pro (13\") - serial: C02XABC12345 - asset tag: RW-3309
iPhone 13 - IMEI: 356789012345678 - asset tag: RW-3310
Docking station - asset tag: RW-3311
```

ken (IT): Thanks. Creating ticket now: IT-23489. Pickup scheduled 04/11 10:00-12:00. Deprovision ticket IT-23490 for EOD 04/10.

maria (People Ops): Manager note — sophia, does the team approve pro-rated bonus? @alex are you the approver here?

alex (Finance): I see the manager approval in Lattice. I will run proration and confirm numbers. Expect final comp + PTO + bonus payout in the 04/15 payroll cycle (subject to signoff).

maria (People Ops): Exit interview scheduled 2026-04-09 10:00 with People Ops. @sophia please confirm availability. We'll also send the COBRA packet on 04/11.

sophia (Product): Confirmed for 04/09 10:00. Thanks.

ken (IT): Quick question — any company repos under sophia's personal GitHub/org or service accounts? Need to audit before removing org memberships.

sophia (Product): I only used my personal GitHub for OSS; no private company repos. I did have access to the 'growth-analytics' BigQuery project via the analytics service account.

maria (People Ops): Note: 'growth-analytics' needs owner reassignment. @alex can you take ownership before 04/08?

alex (Finance): I'll take ownership and confirm by EOD 2026-04-08.

hr-bot: HR task created: Offboard-1787604321. COBRA packet queued for 2026-04-11. Reminder: People Ops to send PTO + bonus proration by 2026-04-07.

maria (People Ops): Action items recap:
- IT (ken): schedule pickup (04/11) + deprovision (EOD 04/10) — tickets IT-23489, IT-23490
- Finance (alex): confirm final paycheck + prorated bonus + PTO payout (04/15 payroll)
- Manager (alex): accept ownership transfer for growth-analytics by 04/08
- People Ops (maria): send COBRA packet 04/11, run PTO calc and post to #payroll-channel by 04/07, run exit interview 04/09

sophia (Product): One small ask — can I keep my personal GitHub account membership to continue OSS work? I did not push any company code to that account.

ken (IT): If there are no company repositories linked, we can remove org membership and keep personal account intact. I will run a repo audit and confirm.

maria (People Ops): Thanks everyone. I'll update the people-ops offboard tracker and ping if anything changes. :thumbsup:
